subject: Initial MAP: Cost & latency alignment for FintechX
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP: Cost & latency alignment for FintechX

Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our conversation I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused only on the cost/performance items we'll own during onboarding so you and your infra team can validate tradeoffs quickly. Attached: FintechX_MAP_v1.pdf and a small quantization profile summary (quant_profiles_summary.csv). Key proposals below so they’re inline: 

- Sample workload & acceptance criteria: 400 RPS sustained peak with 95th perc latency < 180ms for 512-token average responses; throughput target for daytime business hours 250 RPS.
- Batching: conservative initial window 20ms (adaptive target 15–40ms). We'll measure tail impact and iterate.
- Caching: prefix-level KV caching for top-30% of repetitive prompts (auth flow, balance checks). Expected token reduction 18–25% for test dataset.
- Quantization profiles: propose starting with INT8 (aggressive) on the non-critical model variant and FP16 for the primary model. See quant_profiles_summary.csv for latency/cost estimates per profile.
- Routing policy: primary route -> redwood-medium-fp16 (low latency), fallback -> redwood-small-int8 (cost-saving, higher variance). Auto-failover on 5xx or latency > 600ms sustained.
- Metrics & acceptance: we'll share per-route token cost, P95 latency, and model-level throughput dashboards.

Owners & timeline (2-week initial phase):
- FintechX: provision staging endpoints + traffic mirror (owner: Alex) — target by 2026-09-10
- Redwood (me): deploy MAP changes, enable prefix caching, and smoke-test quant profiles — target by 2026-09-13
- Monica/Rishi: cost estimate & billing align (owner: Monica) — target by 2026-09-12

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical sync Thursday 2026-09-09 to confirm staging access and share a short smoke-test script. Please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Customer Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: FintechX_MAP_v1.pdf, quant_profiles_summary.csv

Appreciate the clear MAP and the attachments. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Throughput clarification: the 400 RPS peak you listed is for our global traffic or a single-region burst? We expect ~300 RPS from NA and ~100 RPS from EU at day 30.
2) For the quant profiles — can you call out estimated token-cost delta (USD per 1k tokens) between FP16 and INT8 in the CSV? That will help procurement.
3) Staging: I can get you mirror endpoints by 2026-09-10 but procurement needs a cost range to allow access (they're looping in a PO). CC'ing procurement.

I can do the Thursday sync (09/09) at either 9:30am PT or 11:00am PT. Prefer 9:30.
